from checkconf import main


def test_main_reports_an_unknown_key(tmp_path, capsys):
    settings = tmp_path / 'service.conf'

cat > checkconf.py <<'EOF'
KNOWN_KEYS = {'name', 'port', 'debug'}


def main(argv):
    unknown = 0
    with open(argv[0]) as settings:
        for line in settings:
            key = line.split('=', 1)[0].strip()
            if key not in KNOWN_KEYS:
                print(f'unknown key: {key}')
                unknown += 1
    return 1 if unknown else 0
EOF
cat >> tests/test_checkconf.py <<'EOF'


def run(tmp_path, capsys, text):
    settings = tmp_path / 'service.conf'
    settings.write_text(text)
    status = main([str(settings)])
    return status, capsys.readouterr().out


def test_main_returns_1_for_an_unknown_key(tmp_path, capsys):
    status, _ = run(tmp_path, capsys, 'name = web\ncolour = red\n')
    assert status == 1


def test_main_accepts_all_known_keys(tmp_path, capsys):
    status, out = run(tmp_path, capsys, 'name = web\nport = 80\ndebug = on\n')
    assert (status, out) == (0, '')


def test_main_reports_every_unknown_key_in_order(tmp_path, capsys):
    status, out = run(tmp_path, capsys, 'colour = red\nport = 1\nsize = 2\n')
    assert (status, out) == (1, 'unknown key: colour\nunknown key: size\n')


def test_main_accepts_an_empty_file(tmp_path, capsys):
    assert run(tmp_path, capsys, '') == (0, '')


def test_main_treats_key_names_as_case_sensitive(tmp_path, capsys):
    status, out = run(tmp_path, capsys, 'Name = web\n')
    assert (status, out) == (1, 'unknown key: Name\n')
EOF
